text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Now! Here we go, Bakushin O-senpai! 『Full 
Power Unleashed! Justice Burst』!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Not yet!! "One Good Deed a Day! Bakushin 
Toast"!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, she copied me?! And she got it a 
little wrong, too~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a result of their intense rivalry...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? Neither Sakura Bakushin O nor 
Biko Pegasus could win.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, but that's Sakura Bakushin O for 
you! Hilarious as always!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, in the end, I couldn't get 1st 
place... And Bakushin O-senpai stole all 
the spotlight, too...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I won't get discouraged! Just like 
Carrotman!"

Amidst all the chaos, Biko Pegasus never 
got the chance to take center stage...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Biko-san! Good work out there. Man, we 
both really messed up, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Still, that was a run well worth watching! 
As expected, you are the Umamusume I saw 
potential in.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Bakushin O-senpai! Next time... 
Next time, I'll definitely win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Next, you say...? Hehe, today's contest 
was at 1200m, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What would happen under slightly different 
conditions? Like in a mile race, for 
instance.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A mile race... Which means...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll be waiting for you next at the 
1600m GⅠ, the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A mile race, huh? Alright, let's go. I'm 
gonna do this!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to beat the strongest, Bakushin 
O-senpai, at 1600m!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oops. I am certainly strong, but when it 
comes to 1600m, there are other Umamusume 
who cannot be underestimated.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Never let your guard down, and never 
forget! There's another boss in the 
current sprint division.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The other boss...

And so, the first clash against Sakura 
Bakushin O concluded. The challenge was 
carried over to the next mile race.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Today, I truly, truly gave it 
everything I had... More than ever 
before...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
To stand against Bakushin O-senpai, I even 
unlocked Overclock Mode...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, maybe I pushed myself a bit too 
hard...

Yeah, maybe you pushed yourself a little 
too hard...

text_block_list.text:
Overclocking. In other words, pushing for 
an unreasonable acceleration that one 
would normally avoid, just to compete.

For Biko Pegasus, it must have been a big 
match she desperately wanted to win, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I feel like... everyone was only 
looking at Bakushin O-senpai..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My breathing is... so rough... And my legs 
are hurting a bit... Ugh...

A heavy strain suddenly placed on legs 
that were already fragile to begin with. 
As expected, the price to pay—was not 
zero.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan, are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, miss! You came!

After the checkup ended, the action 
actress lady went out of her way to come 
to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: So, what were the test results?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, it's no big deal! I just 
have to lay off intense training for a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, a blessing in disguise, really.
Yeah, it was a blessing in disguise.

text_block_list.text:
According to the diagnosis, it wasn't a 
fracture or anything of the sort. It seems 
she'll be able to enter the Mile CS in 
about two months without issue, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't be able to do any intense 
training for a while, and it feels like 
I'm gonna have way too much free time...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So because of that, I've been feeling a 
bit down, or maybe...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Right. So you'll have some free time. In 
that case..."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Biko-chan, would it be okay if I came to 
see you for a little while?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh, your older sister did!?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I don't have any location shoots for 
a while, so I should be able to drop by 
pretty often.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Trainer, got a sec?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really!? Yay yay, yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's talk about all kinds of things! I 
wanna hear what Big Sis has been up to 
lately, too!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course! Nice to meet you! I just 
wanted to cheer Biko-chan up, even if only 
a little.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
A true hero smiles brightest in a pinch! 
Right?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

A brief period of recuperation. And so, 
until the Mile Championship, Big Sis made 
a point to visit frequently.
